sn3.8:2.2: “So, sir, while I was upstairs in the stilt longhouse together with Queen Mallikā, I told the queen Mallikā:
sn3.8:2.3: ‘Mallikā, is there anyone more dear to you than yourself?’
sn3.8:2.4: When I had spoken thus, sir, the queen Mallikā said to me:
sn3.8:2.6: But is there anyone more dear to you than yourself?’
sn3.8:2.7: And when I had spoken thus, sir, I told the queen Mallikā:
sn3.8:2.8: ‘For me also, Mallikā, there’s no one.’”
